title: Loudoun Museum

services.name: Virtual Exhibits
services.desc: Explore this StoryMap featuring images and information about Lafayette's visit to Loudoun County two-hundred years ago. Scroll through the content and the image sliders will change simple sketches to vibrant photography. In 2021 and 2022, Loudoun Museum created a series of videos exploring the history of Loudoun County through a photographic lens. These videos show change over time in several towns throughout the county by focusing on some of their most unique sites. (Photography by Sara Wolfley) Explore Yardley Taylor's 1853 map of Loudoun County at a detailed level.
